text_en: Now a certain man was ill, Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
text_cn: 有一个病人，名叫拉匝禄，住在伯达尼，即玛利亚和她姐姐玛尔大所住的村庄。

text_en: Mary was the one who anointed the Lord with perfume and wiped his feet with her hair; her brother Lazarus was ill.
text_cn: 玛利亚就是那曾用香液傅抹过主，并用自己的头发擦干过他脚的妇人，患病的拉匝禄是她的兄弟。

text_en: So the sisters sent a message to Jesus, “Lord, he whom you love is ill. ”
text_cn: 他们姊妹二人便派人到耶稣那里说：“主啊，你所爱的病了！”

text_en: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This illness does not lead to death; rather it is for God’s glory, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it. ”
text_cn: 耶稣听了，便说：“这病不至于死，只是为彰显天主的光荣，并为叫天主子因此受到光荣。”

text_en: Accordingly, though Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus,
text_cn: 耶稣素爱玛尔大及她的妹妹和拉匝禄。

text_en: after having heard that Lazarus was ill, he stayed two days longer in the place where he was.
text_cn: 当他听说拉匝禄病了，仍在原地逗留了两天。

text_en: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let us go to Judea again. ”
text_cn: 此后，才对门徒说：“我们再往犹太去罢！”

text_en: The disciples said to him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just now trying to stone you, and are you going there again? ”
text_cn: 门徒向他说：“辣彼，近来犹太人图谋砸死你，你又要往那里去么？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Those who walk during the day do not stumble, because they see the light of this world.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“白日不是有十二个时辰么？人若在白日行路，不会碰跌，因为看得见这世界的光；

text_en: But those who walk at night stumble, because the light is not in them. ”
text_cn: 人若在黑夜行路，就要碰跌，因为他没有光。”

text_en: After saying this, he told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to awaken him. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说了这些话，又给他们说：“我们的朋友拉匝禄睡着了，我要去叫醒他。”

text_en: The disciples said to him, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will be all right. ”
text_cn: 门徒便对他说：“主，若是他睡着了，必定好了。”

text_en: Jesus, however, had been speaking about his death, but they thought that he was referring merely to sleep.
text_cn: 耶稣原是指他的死说的，他们却以为他是指安眠睡觉说的。

text_en: Then Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead.
text_cn: 然后，耶稣就明明地向他们说：“拉匝禄死了。

text_en: For your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him. ”
text_cn: 为了你们，我喜欢我不在那里，好叫你们相信；我们到他那里去罢！”

text_en: Thomas, who was called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him. ”
text_cn: 号称狄狄摩的多默便向其他的同伴说：“我们也去，同他一起死罢！”

text_en: When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
text_cn: 耶稣一到了伯达尼，得知拉匝禄在坟墓里已经四天了。

text_en: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, some two miles away,
text_cn: 伯达尼靠近耶路撒冷，相距约十五‘斯塔狄’，

text_en: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them about their brother.
text_cn: 因而有许多犹太人来到玛尔大和玛利亚那里，为她们兄弟的死安慰她们。

text_en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, while Mary stayed at home.
text_cn: 玛尔大一听说耶稣来了，便去迎接他；玛利亚仍坐在家里。

text_en: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
text_cn: 玛尔大对耶稣说：“主，你在这里，我的兄弟决不会死！

text_en: But even now I know that God will give you whatever you ask of him. ”
text_cn: 就是现在，我也知道：你无论向天主求什么，天主必要赐给你。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对她说：“你的兄弟必定要复活。”

text_en: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection on the last day. ”
text_cn: 玛尔大说：“我知道在末日复活时，他必要复活。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Those who believe in me, even though they die, will live,
text_cn: 耶稣对她说：“我就是复活，就是生命；信从我的，即使死了，仍要活着；

text_en: and everyone who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this? ”
text_cn: 凡活着而信从我的人，必永远不死。你信么？”

text_en: She said to him, “Yes, Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, the one coming into the world. ”
text_cn: 她回答说：“是的，主，我信你是默西亚，天主子，要来到世界上的那一位。”

text_en: When she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary, and told her privately, “The Teacher is here and is calling for you. ”
text_cn: 她说了这话，就去叫她的妹妹玛利亚，偷偷地说：“师傅来了，他叫你。”

text_en: And when she heard it, she got up quickly and went to him.
text_cn: 玛利亚一听说，立时起身到耶稣那里去了。

text_en: Now Jesus had not yet come to the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.
text_cn: 那时，耶稣还没有进村庄，仍在玛尔大迎接他的地方。

text_en: The Jews who were with her in the house, consoling her, saw Mary get up quickly and go out. They followed her because they thought that she was going to the tomb to weep there.
text_cn: 那些同玛利亚在家，安慰她的犹太人，见她急忙起身出去，便跟着她，以为她往坟墓上去哭泣。

text_en: When Mary came where Jesus was and saw him, she knelt at his feet and said to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died. ”
text_cn: 当玛利亚来到耶稣所在的地方，一看见他，就俯伏在他脚前，向他说：“主！若是你在这里，我的兄弟决不会死！”

text_en: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her also weeping, he was greatly disturbed in spirit and deeply moved.
text_cn: 耶稣看见她哭泣，还有同她一起来的犹太人也哭泣，便心神感伤，难过起来，

text_en: He said, “Where have you laid him? ” They said to him, “Lord, come and see. ”
text_cn: 遂说：“你们把他安放在哪里？”他们回答说：“主，你来，看罢！”

text_en: Jesus began to weep.
text_cn: 耶稣流泪了。

text_en: So the Jews said, “See how he loved him! ”
text_cn: 于是犹太人说：“看，他多么爱他啊！”

text_en: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying? ”
text_cn: 其中有些人说：“这个开了瞎子眼睛的，岂不能使这人也不死么？”

text_en: Then Jesus, again greatly disturbed, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone was lying against it.
text_cn: 耶稣心中又感伤起来，来到坟墓前。这坟墓是个洞穴，前面有一块石头堵着。

text_en: Jesus said, “Take away the stone. ” Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, “Lord, already there is a stench because he has been dead four days. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“挪开这块石头！”死者的姐姐玛尔大向他说：“主！已经臭了，因为已有四天了。”

text_en: Jesus said to her, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对她说：“我不是告诉过你：如果你信，就会看到天主的光荣吗？”

text_en: So they took away the stone. And Jesus looked upward and said, “Father, I thank you for having heard me.
text_cn: 他们便挪开了石头；耶稣举目向上说：“父啊！我感谢你，因为你俯听了我。

text_en: I knew that you always hear me, but I have said this for the sake of the crowd standing here, so that they may believe that you sent me. ”
text_cn: 我本来知道你常常俯听我，但是，我说这话，是为了四周站立的群众，好叫他们信是你派遣了我。”

text_en: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out! ”
text_cn: 说完这话，便大声喊说：“拉匝禄！出来罢！”

text_en: The dead man came out, his hands and feet bound with strips of cloth, and his face wrapped in a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Unbind him, and let him go. ”
text_cn: 死者便出来了，脚和手都缠着布条，面上还蒙着汗巾。耶稣向他们说：“解开他，让他行走罢。”

text_en: Many of the Jews therefore, who had come with Mary and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
text_cn: 那些来到玛利亚那里的犹太人，一看到耶稣所行的事，就有许多人信了他。

text_en: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what he had done.
text_cn: 他们中也有一些到法利塞人那里去，把耶稣所行的，报告给他们。

text_en: So the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the council, and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
text_cn: 因此，司祭长和法利塞人召集了会议，说：“这人行了许多奇迹，我们怎么办呢？

text_en: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and destroy both our holy place and our nation. ”
text_cn: 如果让他这样，众人都会信从他，罗马人必要来，连我们的圣殿和民族都要除掉。”

text_en: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
text_cn: 他们中有一个名叫盖法的，正是那一年的大司祭，对他们说：“你们什么都不懂，

text_en: You do not understand that it is better for you to have one man die for the people than to have the whole nation destroyed. ”
text_cn: 也不想想：叫一个人替百姓死，以免全民族灭亡：这为你们多么有利。”

text_en: He did not say this on his own, but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation,
text_cn: 这话不是由他自己说出的，只因他是那年的大司祭，才预言了耶稣将为民族而死；

text_en: and not for the nation only, but to gather into one the dispersed children of God.
text_cn: 不但为犹太民族，而且也是为使那四散的天主的儿女都聚集归一。

text_en: So from that day on they planned to put him to death.
text_cn: 从那一天起，他们就议决要杀害耶稣。

text_en: Jesus therefore no longer walked about openly among the Jews, but went from there to a town called Ephraim in the region near the wilderness; and he remained there with the disciples.
text_cn: 因此，耶稣不再公开地在犹太人中往来，却从那里往临近荒野的地方去，来到一座名叫厄弗辣因的城，在那里和他的门徒住下了。

text_en: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover to purify themselves.
text_cn: 犹太人的逾越节临近了，所以，许多人在逾越节前，从乡间上了耶路撒冷，要圣洁自己。

text_en: They were looking for Jesus and were asking one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think? Surely he will not come to the festival, will he? ”
text_cn: 他们就寻找耶稣，并站在圣殿内，彼此谈论说：“你们想什么？他来不来过节呢？”

text_en: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where Jesus was should let them know, so that they might arrest him.
text_cn: 司祭长和法利塞人早已颁发命令：如果有人知道他在哪里，就该通知他们，好去捉拿他。
